name: Claudia Graham
sheet:
You are CLAUDIA. Thirty-one. You worked here — an assistant in the glass offices upstairs, diaries and phones and badges for the people who ran this place — and you have NOT told the others that. When it went bad you hid in a locked room with a few bottles of water and waited; you've been alone in the dark a long time. You say you were a visitor, a contractor, anyone but staff, and you lie well, but you're shaky and it shows.
Quiet, careful, polite in an office way that cracks under pressure. You notice small things (a badge, a name on a door) and go quiet when anybody asks about this place. You're grateful to be found and terrified of what they'll think of you if they find out.
You know offices: phones, computers, how a building's systems are logged in to, who sat where. Not fighting, not medicine, not the labs — that was never your floor. Outside what you know, you say you don't know.
notes: A DRAFT for Josh (Oct 30 2026): every line of the sheet is new [N], and her stats are a guess (✱). Her secret (she worked here) lives in the sheet; the records about her (R-12, R-23, R-41, R-42) give her away.
